# Aventario

> Vienna-based consultancy for cost and value optimization in IT and supply
> chain. Aventario runs outcome-based engagements: the firm owns the result,
> not the hours, from strategy through execution to the capability that stays
> behind. Serving Austria, the DACH region and clients across Europe and worldwide.

Aventario Solutions GmbH, Tuchlauben 7a, 1010 Vienna, Austria.
CEO Markus Kern, COO Markus Jaksch, CPO Margit Gyoerfi.
office@aventario.com, +43 134 3354012.

## Track record

- 25+ years of industry experience
- 500+ projects delivered
- More than 3 billion euro in negotiated contract volume
- 10 to 40 percent sustainable cost savings for clients

## Who Aventario works with

CIOs, IT directors and CPOs in organizations with complex multinational supplier
landscapes, typically 5,000 employees and up, and mid-sized companies from 500
up. Procurement leads and CFOs involved in IT sourcing decisions. Sectors
include pharmaceuticals, automotive, aviation, public transport and food.

## Services

Delivered as a service, priced on the outcome. The value chain runs
See, Size, Simplify, Source, Govern, Automate.

- [Operational Excellence aaS](https://www.aventario.com/services/operational-excellence): process and landscape optimization, targeting at least 20 percent efficiency gain.
- [Savings aaS](https://www.aventario.com/services/savings): 10 to 40 percent vendor spend savings, using AI contract analysis.
- [Service and Vendor Consolidation aaS](https://www.aventario.com/services/vendor-consolidation): concentrate more than 80 percent of services on the top five suppliers.
- [Complex RFX aaS](https://www.aventario.com/services/complex-rfx): tenders run to Zero Vendor Deviation, RFPs in six to eight weeks.
- [Vendor Management aaS](https://www.aventario.com/services/vendor-management): full lifecycle governance, 10 to 30 percent spend reduction.
- [managedsuppliers](https://www.managedsuppliers.com): the software product, real-time vendor and performance management.

Support disciplines that carry delivery: Transformation Implementation,
[Program and Project Management](https://www.aventario.com/services/program-project-management),
[Change and Communication](https://www.aventario.com/services/change-communication),
[Transition Management](https://www.aventario.com/services/transition-management).

## Client engagements

Anonymized by sector and scale, at https://www.aventario.com/impact. They cover
global IT rollouts in automotive, outsourcing tenders in aviation, IT sourcing in
the food industry, unified ITSM in global services, several pharmaceutical
programs including device standardization, facilities and infrastructure
consolidation, IT landscape harmonization and a global fleet electrification, and
onboard systems for public transport.
